DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT TOP 1
@PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY =FULLDATE
FROM
EDS.DATE_DIM
WHERE
FULLDATE<@DateProcessed
AND Business_Day_Flag='Y'
AND FULLDATE=DATEADD(day,1,Previous_Business_Day)
ORDER BY
FULLDATE DESC;

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BAL_BDATE AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BAL_BDATE = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY;

		ELSE GAM.SANCT_LIM * BCC.ConversionRate

		ELSE BCC.ConversionRate
		END AS numeric(22,4)) CONVERSION_RATE

		  ELSE EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL * BCC.ConversionRate END AS DECIMAL(25,4)) OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_PHP
	,EAB.VALUE_DATE_BAL AS OUTSTANDING_CLR_BAL_ORIG
	,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN EAB.VALUE_DATE_BAL
		  ELSE EAB.VALUE_DATE_BAL * BCC.ConversionRate END AS DECIMAL(25,4)) OUTSTANDING_CLR_BAL_PHP
	,DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10),  LEFT(RIGHT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120)) AS DAY_OF_YEAR 
	FROM (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_LNS_GENERALACCTMASTFULL WHERE H = 'D' AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) = @DateProcessed ) GAM
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_LNS_EODACCTBALFULL WHERE H = 'D' AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) = @DateProcessed ) EAB 
	ON GAM.ACID = EAB.ACID AND GAM.BANK_ID = EAB.BANK_ID
	LEFT JOIN  (SELECT * FROM bnkm.currencyconversion where ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' AND CurrencyConversionTimestamp = @DateProcessed )  BCC ON 
	GAM.BANK_ID = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId
	AND GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId
	LEFT JOIN EDS.LNS_LAACCTMAST LAM
		ON LAM.ACID = GAM.ACID
		AND LAM.BANK_ID = GAM.BANK_ID
		AND  @DateProcessed BETWEEN LAM.SCD_Start_Date AND LAM.SCD_End_Date
--WHERE GAM.ACID='PA912015'

		, TMP.GAM_ACID
		, TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
		, TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
		, TMP.GAM_SCHM_TYPE

		, (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_ORIG,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_ORIG,0) END) AS OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_ORIG
		, (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_PHP,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_PHP,0) END) AS OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_PHP
		, 
		(CASE WHEN TMP.Previous_Business_Day=DATEADD(day,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_PHP,0) + coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PHP,0) ELSE		
		SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_PHP,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_PHP,0) END)
			OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID,TMP.GAM_BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) +  coalesce(DF.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PHP,0) END)  AS ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PHP
		, 
		(CASE WHEN TMP.Previous_Business_Day=DATEADD(day,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_ORIG,0) + coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_ORIG,0) ELSE		
		SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_ORIG,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_ORIG,0) END)
			OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID,TMP.GAM_BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) +  coalesce(DF.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_ORIG,0) END)  AS ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_ORIG
			
		, CAST(TMP.DAYOFYEAR AS SMALLINT) DAYOFYEAR
		, LastDayOfMonth
		, CAST(Day AS SMALLINT) Day
		, month_end_diff
		, (
					(
						(CASE WHEN TMP.Previous_Business_Day=DATEADD(day,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_ORIG,0) + coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_ORIG,0) ELSE		
		SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_ORIG,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_ORIG,0) END)

					) / (TMP.DAYOFYEAR + case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)

					) / (TMP.DAYOFYEAR + case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)

		, (((CASE WHEN TMP.Previous_Business_Day=DATEADD(day,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) AND MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE)=MONTH(TMP.Previous_Business_Day) THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_ORIG,0) + coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.MTD_AGG_CURR_BAL_ORIG,0) ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_ORIG,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_CURR_BAL_ORIG,0) END)

		) 
		/ (DAY + case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff  else 0 end)

		, (

					(
